items.question: Do I need the official Meta API to start?
items.answer: No. You can start today with the number you already use, without waiting for approval. When it makes sense for your business, you can migrate to the official WhatsApp API.

items.question: What if my team doesn't adopt the tool?
items.answer: AI and follow-up run on their own, so the process doesn't depend on everyone changing habits. The team steps in when the lead is already qualified.

items.question: Are my data and my customers' data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Messages and personal data are protected, and each account's data is isolated from other Sales Flow customers.

items.question: Do I need to code or be technical?
items.answer: No. The dashboard was built so business owners and support teams can set it up themselves, no developer needed.
